covered.label: Metro (A, B, C)
covered.detail: 58 of 58 metro stations, three lines, live departures. Flora and four Line C stations (Budějovická, Kačerov, Pankrác, Roztyly) are in the catalog but currently show no service — see notCovered; the app detects this automatically from the static feed and shows the reason plus replacement transport instead of a blank board, and will resume showing live departures the moment the feed does, with no app change needed.

notCovered.label: Flora (Line A)
notCovered.detail: No live metro service currently scheduled (confirmed both in the PID GTFS static snapshot and 9/9 clean live Golemio polls, 28 Sep 2026) - long-term station reconstruction (trains pass through without stopping), since 2 Feb 2026, until further notice - use Jiřího z Poděbrad or Želivského instead, or nearby trams 10/11/16 (Náměstí Míru), 13 (Jiřího z Poděbrad), 16 (Želivského).

notCovered.label: Budějovická, Kačerov, Pankrác, Roztyly (Line C)
notCovered.detail: Temporary bidirectional closure of Metro C between Pražského povstání and Chodov for track repair, Sat 26 Sep 2026 04:30 - Mon 28 Sep 2026 23:59 (DPP "Omezení a mimořádné události" notice) - confirmed in the PID GTFS static snapshot (zero scheduled stop_times for these four stations' platforms until service resumes 29 Sep 2026). Replacement bus XC runs Pražského povstání – Pankrác – Budějovická – Kačerov – Roztyly – Dědinova – Chodov while the closure is in effect. Expected to resume normal service 29 Sep 2026; the app detects this automatically and will stop showing this notice the moment the feed does, with no app change needed.

notCovered.label: Line D
notCovered.detail: Under construction; no passenger service yet. Not shown.

stations: 58 metro stations. Flora and four Line C stations (Budějovická, Kačerov, Pankrác, Roztyly) are catalogued but currently show no scheduled service - see notCovered.
notes: Muzeum is the inner-city hub where lines A and C cross; it never appears as a direction. No single station serves all three lines — Můstek (A x B) and Florenc (B x C) are the other two interchanges, each a separate stop from Muzeum. Flora and four Line C stations (Budějovická, Kačerov, Pankrác, Roztyly) currently show no scheduled service — see notCovered for reasons and replacement transport; the app detects this automatically from the static feed (rather than a fixed list of dates), so it stops showing the notice as soon as PID's feed shows the station served again.
